compiled:
📰 General

Drone Strike Compromises Chernobyl’s Protective Shield, Raising Radiation Concerns •

A recent drone strike against the Chernobyl exclusion zone in Ukraine has damaged the structure designed to contain radioactive waste. The International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA) reports that the protective shield is no longer effectively limiting the spread of radiation. The strike occurred earlier this year and has created a breach in the barrier’s integrity. Monitoring efforts are underway to assess the extent of the damage and its impact on surrounding areas.

🌍 World

Four Arrested After Custard and Crumble Attack on Tower of London Jewels •

Four individuals were arrested following an incident at the Tower of London on Saturday. Police responded to reports of custard and apple crumble being thrown at a display case protecting part of the Crown Jewels. The incident occurred shortly before 10:00 GMT and targeted the Imperial State Crown. Investigations are ongoing, and the suspects are currently in police custody awaiting questioning regarding the vandalism.

🦅 US

Apple’s Chip Lead Johny Srouji Weighing Departure, Report Indicates •

Apple’s Senior Vice President of Hardware Technologies, Johny Srouji, is reportedly contemplating a departure from the company. A Bloomberg report indicates he is seriously considering alternative career opportunities. Srouji is primarily recognized for his leadership in developing Apple Silicon chips. The report suggests this decision is under active consideration, though details regarding his potential destination remain undisclosed.

💰 Business

Trump Pardons Golf Buddy’s Client Following Round of Golf with Trey Gowdy •

President Donald Trump issued a pardon to Michael Sussman, a client of Trey Gowdy, following a round of golf played on November 16th. The pardon reversed the Justice Department’s efforts to pursue fair pricing for live event ticket purchasers. Gowdy reportedly played 18 holes with Trump, influencing the President’s decision. The pardon marks a notable instance of personal relationships impacting legal proceedings within the Trump administration.

💻 Technology

Leak Suggests ‘Marvel vs. Capcom 5’ Reveal Could Occur at The Game Awards 2025 •

The Game Awards 2025, slated for December 11th, 2025, is anticipated to feature multiple game announcements. A recent leak indicates a strong possibility of ‘Marvel vs. Capcom 5’ being revealed at the event. The leak stems from discussions surrounding potential game announcements during the presentation. This would represent a significant moment for fans of the long-awaited fighting game series.

🎭 Entertainment

Jane Fonda Declares Netflix-Warner Bros. Deal a “Catastrophic” Threat to Film •

Actress Jane Fonda has publicly criticized the recently finalized merger between Netflix and Warner Bros. Discovery. She described the $82.7 billion acquisition as “catastrophic,” arguing it poses a significant risk to the creative film industry. Fonda expressed concerns that the deal could lead to a decline in independent films and a shift towards streaming-focused content. The acquisition combines the streaming giant with the traditional media conglomerate, creating a dominant force in entertainment.

🏅 Sports

Steelers Coach Schottenheimer Addresses Concerns Over George Pickens’s Richard Sherman Post •

Steelers head coach Brian Schottenheimer acknowledged a perception created by wide receiver George Pickens following Thursday’s game. The coach expressed a concern regarding the actions taken by Pickens on Friday, specifically referencing a social media post. Details of the post remain undisclosed, but Schottenheimer indicated it prompted a conversation with the player. The coach’s comments suggest a desire to clarify the situation and address any potential misunderstandings.

🔬 Science

Astronomers Find Planet Orbiting Star in Unprecedented, Highly-Tilted Path •

Astronomers have identified the exoplanet TOI-3884b orbiting a star with a highly unusual orbital inclination of approximately 62 degrees. This extreme tilt represents a significant deviation from typical planetary orbits around stars. Scientists are currently investigating the reasons behind this peculiar alignment, exploring potential gravitational interactions or past collisions. The discovery offers a unique opportunity to study the dynamics of planetary systems. Further research will focus on understanding the forces shaping this unusual system.

🩺 Health

Study Reveals Top Foods Driving Chronic Inflammation – What You Need to Know •

Research indicates that certain foods significantly contribute to chronic inflammation, a key factor in numerous health issues. The study, referencing data from the National Library of Medicine, identifies specific dietary components as major drivers of this inflammatory response. These include foods high in added sugars, refined carbohydrates, and processed oils. Elevated inflammation is associated with conditions like diabetes, heart disease, and arthritis, highlighting the importance of dietary choices in managing these risks.
